patch.role: One-occurrence leg: rewrites a single double backtick.
Removes NUL bytes; NUL never occurs in the declared inputs.
Removes carriage returns; the declared inputs are LF-only.
Decodes one HTML entity; no declared input carries it.

inputs.expose_two_backticks: text with two `` markers: only the first is repaired

rationale: educateBackticks() opens a primary quote at every `` marker. The patch rewrites one marker only; the second marker in a two-marker string stays raw and exposes the gap.

challenge.note: Only the candidate universe grows. A, the original U blocks and the declared inputs are unchanged, so every correct relation is unchanged; the added candidates are irrelevant on every declared input.
